methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN News — Economic Development is the topic-scoped RSS 2.0 feed of the United Nations news service (news.un.org) covering the economic-development desk: trade, financing for development, debt, employment, poverty reduction and macroeconomic reporting from UN agencies such as UNCTAD, DESA and the regional commissions.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL scopes content to the economic-development topic on the server side; any finer keyword match must be applied in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Topic scoping to economic development is fixed by the feed URL. Beyond that only client-side filters apply: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no per-item `<category>`/`dc:subject` tags, so no secondary category filter is available.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML article page. Each item also has an `<enclosure>` pointing to a JPEG lead image, not a PDF; no direct document downloads are offered.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~30 items; no historical pagination beyond the feed window and no archive parameter.
probeNotes: Reachable, valid RSS 2.0. Observed 30 items. Fields: title, link, description, guid, pubDate, enclosure (JPEG), source. Namespaces include content:encoded and MRSS. No <category>/dc:subject tags. No PDF links.
